Regularized incomplete gamma function (C backend)

Source: R/prim.R
cgamcdf.Rd

The lower regularized incomplete gamma function \(P(a, x)\), the distribution function of a gamma distribution with shape a and unit rate; the p-value of a chi-square statistic \(q\) on \(k\) degrees of freedom is \(1 - P(k/2, q/2)\).

Usage

cgamcdf(shape, x)

Arguments

shape

The shape \(a\), one positive number.

x

Numeric vector of quantiles.

Value

A numeric vector of probabilities, the length of x.

Details

$$P(a, x) = \frac{1}{\Gamma(a)} \int_0^x t^{a-1} e^{-t} \, dt,$$ computed by the package's own gamma kernel, which agrees with stats::pgamma(x, shape) to rounding. For a rate \(r\), pass x * r. A negative x gives 0, NA gives NA and Inf gives 1; shape = Inf gives 0 for every finite x, as pgamma() does.

See also

stats::pgamma().

Examples

cgamcdf(3.5, c(0.5, 1, 4, 12))
#> [1] 0.005171463 0.040159631 0.667406097 0.998860649
all.equal(cgamcdf(3.5, c(0.5, 1, 4, 12)),
          stats::pgamma(c(0.5, 1, 4, 12), shape = 3.5))
#> [1] TRUE
1 - cgamcdf(2 / 2, 5.99 / 2)
#> [1] 0.05003663
try(cgamcdf(0, 1))
#> Error : cgamcdf: `shape` must be one positive number.
